snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame playthrough - withers ver. 0.03
snippet.description:
Content warning:
- Blood, gore, and violence
- Body horror
- Scopophobia
- Jumpscares
- Depiction of bodily organs (specifically umbilical cord and fetus)
- Bright colors and flashing lights

Read more about this fangame: https://ynfg.yume.wiki/Withers
Download: https://ux.getuploader.com/withers/download/11

TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 Starting the game
2:19 Getting Wheelchair, Marmot, and Scarecrow EFFECTS, Seeing Camping in the Wilderness EVENT
9:29 Getting Eyeball Flower EFFECT
11:03 Getting Hoodie and Blanket EFFECTS
18:08 Getting Snail and Drip Stand EFFECTS, Seeing Closer Casualties EVENT
29:50 Getting Flower Vase EFFECT
33:32 Getting Wings, Hat & Coat, and Range EFFECTS
42:04 Activating some Quick Functions for the Wings and Eyeball Flower effects
42:48 Getting Scarf EFFECT
43:53 Getting Mushroom EFFECT, wandering around for a bit
46:24 Getting Harmonica and Bubble EFFECTS
54:10 Seeing Prison Cell 12 EVENT (takes a while to trigger)
